title: pharbitis sessiliflora
intro: Pharbitis sessiliflora, commonly known as Rock Bindii or Creeping Jenny, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Convolvulaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of infections. The therapeutic actions of Pharbitis sessiliflora include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. Bioactive constituents of Pharbitis sessiliflora include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
